text:
3. 1. 4. 

Tīhidhammehisuttaṃ

283. tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjati. Katamehi tīhi: idha bhikkhave mātugāmo pubbaṇhasamayaṃ maccheramalapariyuṭaṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, majajhanatikaṃ samayaṃ issā pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, sāyanhasamayaṃ kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato mātugāmo yebhuyyena kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppajjatīti.
